description: This file defines the RejectedPromise class in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, representing a promise that has been rejected. It includes methods for chaining rejection handlers, waiting on the promise, and managing its state.

classes.name: RejectedPromise
classes.description: A class implementing PromiseInterface that represents a promise which has been rejected. It provides methods to handle rejection, wait for the promise resolution, and manage promise state.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a RejectedPromise with the specified reason, throwing an exception if the reason is a promise.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Adds rejection and fulfillment handlers to the promise, returning a new promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Adds a rejection handler, equivalent to then(null, onRejected).

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the promise to settle. Throws an exception if the promise was rejected.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise, which should be 'REJECTED'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the promise, but throws an exception because the promise is already rejected.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise, but only if the reason matches the existing reason.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the promise. Implementation is a no-op.
